However, price is stretched far below EMA20/VWAP into support, increasing pullback risk.

Price is above VAH (73998.28) and above POC (73660.42). CVD is slightly BEARISH (-0.06), showing mild divergence against the price uptrend. Session is NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is trading above VWAP (73764.47) and EMA50 (73890.88). The forming bar pulled back after testing near Session High (74706.2) and is consolidating mid-channel between EMA20 baseline (74067.54) and upper ATR band (74639.76).
